boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Juniata College
boards.description: Ten named campus destinations with official posted access until midnight or later, suitable for under-21 evening study, recreation, and community activities.

cards.title: Ellis Hall After Hours
cards.subtitle: The campus destination with 24/7 posted building access
cards.notes: Use Ellis as the flexible endpoint when other buildings close, but carry your college ID and observe any room-level restrictions.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock campus building for late transitions between dining, student services, and shared spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Ellis Hall as open 24/7 Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official building-hours page lists Ellis Hall as open 24/7 every day; individual offices, dining operations, and rooms may keep shorter hours.

cards.title: The 1 A.M. Academic Run
cards.subtitle: Brumbaugh Academic Center stays open late on weeknights
cards.notes: Plan weeknight project work here before the 1 a.m. close, then leave enough time to collect materials and exit without rushing.
cards.short_summary: A late-closing academic building that extends the usable campus day from Sunday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists the Brumbaugh Academic Center, abbreviated BAC, as open until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted closing time is 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; room access may be more limited.

cards.title: Good Hall at 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Another Sunday-through-Thursday late academic stop
cards.notes: Choose Good Hall for work tied to its classrooms or departments, and verify that the specific room you need remains available.
cards.short_summary: A central academic destination with official access extending to 1 a.m. on five nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Good Hall as open until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted closing time is 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; specialized rooms may require authorization.

cards.title: The Late Science-Building Run
cards.subtitle: von Liebig remains open until 1 a.m. on weeknights
cards.notes: Finish science-centered study before closing and confirm laboratory or equipment access separately from general building access.
cards.short_summary: A named science destination whose general building schedule supports late Sunday-through-Thursday work.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists the von Liebig Center for Science, abbreviated VLB, as open until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted closing time is 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; laboratory access is not established by these hours.

cards.title: Swigart Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: A seven-day campus stop with a midnight close
cards.notes: Treat midnight as a firm endpoint for shared work, and pack up early enough to leave the building on schedule.
cards.short_summary: A consistently late campus building with midnight closing times on both weekdays and weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Swigart Hall as open until midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to midnight every day, opening at 6:00 a.m. weekdays and 9:00 a.m. weekends; individual areas may differ.

cards.title: Carnegie at the Midnight Mark
cards.subtitle: Late access every night of the week
cards.notes: Use the building only for spaces available to you, keep noise low, and begin wrapping up before the posted midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A nightly midnight destination with later morning openings on Saturday and Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Carnegie Hall as open until midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to midnight daily, with 7:00 a.m. weekday and 9:00 a.m. weekend openings; event or room access can vary.

cards.title: Unity House Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A named community destination with late daily hours
cards.notes: Check the current program or room-access rules before heading over, and respect any gathering already using the space.
cards.short_summary: A community-focused campus destination officially scheduled through midnight all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Unity House as open until midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to midnight every day, opening at 6:00 a.m. weekdays and 9:00 a.m. weekends; program access may be narrower.

cards.title: The Midnight Library Run
cards.subtitle: Statton supports late study Sunday through Thursday
cards.notes: Use the learning commons for a focused final study block, and check service-desk or room schedules before relying on assistance.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built study destination open until midnight on the core academic nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Statton Learning Commons as open until midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours end at midnight Sunday through Thursday, 8:00 p.m. Friday, and 5:00 p.m. Saturday; staffed services may close earlier.

cards.title: KSRC at Midnight
cards.subtitle: Late recreation access on every posted day
cards.notes: Check facility, court, pool, and equipment schedules before leaving, since the building close does not guarantee every activity.
cards.short_summary: A recreation destination with general building access posted through midnight seven days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists the Kennedy Sports + Recreation Center, abbreviated KSRC, as open until midnight every day.
cards.access_notes: Official general hours end at midnight daily; openings vary by day, and individual recreation facilities or programs may close earlier.

cards.entity_name: Halbritter Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Halbritter Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: A performing-arts building with late daily access
cards.notes: Confirm rehearsal, studio, or event authorization first, and allow time to secure materials before the midnight building close.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts destination whose general access extends to midnight throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata College lists Halbritter as open until midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours end at midnight daily, with 7:00 a.m. weekday and 9:00 a.m. weekend openings; studios and events may require separate access.
